BETA Close X Bellway PLC has announced the completion of the second tranche of its share buyback programme, having purchased a total of 152,179 ordinary shares between August 24 and August 28, 2026, at a volume-weighted average price of 2,163.25 pence per share, with the highest price paid being 2,214.00 pence and the lowest 2,102.00 pence. These shares will be cancelled, reducing the total number of ordinary shares in issue to 112,460,585. This brings the total shares purchased under the buyback programme to 6,852,847. Disclaimer* Bellway PLC 01 September 2026 Bellway p.l.c. Transaction in Own Shares 01 September 2026 Bellway p.l.c. ('Bellway' or the 'Group') announces that, in accordance with the terms of the share buyback programme (the 'Buyback Programme') announced on 14 October 2025 and the terms of the Second Tranche announced on 2 April 2026, from 24 August 2026 up to and including 28 August 2026 the Group purchased the following number of ordinary shares of 12.5 pence each (the Ordinary Shares') through Deutsche Bank AG. Date Number of shares purchased Highest price paid (GBp) Lowest price paid (GBp) Volume weighted average price (GBp) Trading venue 24 August 2026 43,017 2,132.00 2,102.00 2,121.57 XLON 25 August 2026 33,932 2,162.00 2,144.00 2,155.77 XLON 26 August 2026 25,000 2,214.00 2,192.00 2,208.03 XLON 27 August 2026 35,000 2,200.00 2,174.00 2,191.71 XLON 28 August 2026 15,230 2,180.00 2,152.00 2,158.70 XLON The purchased Ordinary Shares will be cancelled. Since the announcement of the Second Tranche of the Buyback Programme on 2 April 2026, Bellway has purchased 3,894,531 Ordinary Shares in aggregate for cancellation. Bellway has now purchased 6,852,847 Ordinary Shares under the first and second tranche (to date) in aggregate for cancellation under the Buyback Programme. This concludes the Second Tranche of the Buyback Programme announced on 2 April 2026. Following settlement of the above purchases and cancellation of the purchased ordinary shares, the Group's total number of ordinary shares in issue shall be 112,460,585 ordinary shares. In accordance with Article 5(1)(b) of Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 as it applies in the UK (the Market Abuse Regulation), the table below contains detailed information of the individual trades made by Deutsche Bank AG on behalf of Bellway as part of the Buyback Programme.
